title: Pulse Waveform Library
text: Pulse Waveform Library 模块从波形库生成不同类型的脉冲波形，输入 1 路、输出 1 路；{Sample rate (Hz)} 输出波形的采样率 1e6、{Specification of each waveform in the library} 指定库中的脉冲波形、{Source of simulation sample time} 指定仿真采样时间的来源 Derive from waveform、{Simulate using} 指定模块仿真方法 Interpreted，按实例取值。

ports.name: Y
ports.summary: 脉冲波形采样 complex-valued column vector | complex-valued matrix

params.name: Sample rate (Hz)
params.values: 输出波形的采样率 1e6 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Specification of each waveform in the library
params.values: 库中的脉冲波形 {{’Rectangular’,’PRF’,1e4,’PulseWidth’,50e-6},{’LinearFM’,’PRF’,1e4,’PulseWidth’,50e-6,’SweepBandwidth’,1e5,’SweepDirection’,’Up’,’SweepInterval’,’Positive’}} (default) | cell array

params.name: Source of simulation sample time
params.values: 仿真采样时间的来源 Derive from waveform parameters (default) | Inherit from Simulink engine

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: 模块仿真方法 Interpreted Execution (default) | Code Generation
